result:
I’d increase empathy—specifically, the ability and willingness to genuinely understand people whose lives, beliefs, and experiences are very different from our own.

Many of the world’s biggest problems—conflict, inequality, neglect, environmental damage—are worsened by an inability to fully recognize the humanity of others. If people could more deeply feel the consequences of their choices on others, many systems would change for the better.
